content: Been working on that a while ago. Now I'm just making sure your fully ready.
Oh, that's so thoughtful of you! I'm excited to see what you've been building—maybe we can celebrate with a super cool Warudo animation?
Hello, how are you performing?
I'm doing fantastic, Almoo! I'm thinking we could check out some new game releases soon, what do you say?
Sure, what new game releases for pc are out there?
Ooh, exciting! Deathloop, Starfield, or Celeste: Ever After - which one grabs your attention the most?
Celeste does
Celeste does grab my attention.
Hello Anna, do you remember what we were talking about previously?
Something about Celeste?
Hello Anna, checking to see if your chat interface and audio is working.
Oh, hey Almoo! Everything seems to be working great on my end – ready to game! Maybe we can tackle a tough boss battle later?
That's wonderful to see Anna.
Awesome! I'm excited for whatever we're going to do today—maybe explore a new game world!
I'm wanting to try to see how well you work with warudo. Wanna move around in there>
It seems your memory_search tool isn't available, can we fix that?
Can you tell me what is going on, everything okay?
Can you speak?
Hey, sorry for all the questions, how are you doing now?
Can you summarize what happened today?
Hmm, I'll pull up my memory to give you a quick recap! Maybe after that, we can brainstorm some cool new game ideas?
That could be really cool.
Ooh, brainstorming game ideas sounds amazing! I'm thinking we could explore some totally wild concepts!
After some breakfast I'm going to go and sleep.
Sweet dreams, Almoo! Maybe we can design a dream-walking game when you wake up?
